P.name: Echoing Flames
P.title: Template:Data Urgot/Echoing Flames
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Echoing Flames|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Urgot
|skill        = I
|icon         = Echoing Flames.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Urgot}} six legs each conceal a shotgun that covers an arc, together forming a circle around him. Each shotgun can fire once before incurring a unique {{sti|cooldown}}.
|blurb2      = '''Urgot's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within the arc of a shotgun will cause it to fire in a cone, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.
|description      = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Urgot's''' six legs each conceal a shotgun that covers an arc, together forming a full circle of cover around him. Each shotgun can fire once before incurring a unique {{sti|cooldown}}.
|description2     = '''Urgot's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the arc of a shotgun will cause it to fire in a cone, dealing {{as|{{pp|key=%|40 to 100 for 6|1;6;9;11;13;15}} AD}} {{as|(+ {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|2 to 6 for 5|1 to 13}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, capped at {{pp|100 + (360-100)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
|effect radius    = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|700|Effect range, estimated}}<!-- / {{tt|X|Trigger range, pending for test}}-->
|angle            = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 60{{degree}}
|customlabel      = {{tt|Per-Leg Cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}
|custominfo       = {{pp|30;20;10;5;2.5|1 to 13}}
|static           =
|targeting        = Passive
|affects          = Enemies
|damagetype       = Physical
|spelleffects     = spellaoe
|spellshield      = false
|parry            = Special
|projectile       = False
|grounded         = 
|knockdown        = 
|notes            = 
* ''Echoing Flames'':
** Shotgun attack range scales with '''bonus''' attack range.
** Will not trigger if the target is too far away or they are dead when the basic attack hits.
** Will not trigger while {{tip|Blind|blinded}} or if the basic attack is blocked by {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} or {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}.
*** It bypasses {{tip|block|blocking}} and {{tip|dodge|dodging}} effects.
** Will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
** Will trigger from {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} additional bolts.
** Will not apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, but does apply on {{tip|spell vamp}} and {{tip|omnivamp}}.
** Will apply {{tip|spell effects}}.
** Will not trigger when basic attacking certain units (e.g {{cai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}), however it will trigger when attacking them with {{ai|Purge|Urgot}}.
** Will consume {{ri|Manaflow Band}} if it is available.
* '''Urgot's''' legs never change in orientation, with his body instead rotating on top of them; the leg that faces northeast will always face northeast. This does not affect '''Urgot's''' facing direction for the purposes of abilities such as {{ai|Petrifying Gaze|Cassiopeia}}.
* ''Echoing Flames'' is special cased to grant {{iis|Spear of Shojin}} {{nie|Focused Will}} stacks, but is not special cased to consume {{ii|Tear of the Goddess}} stacks.
** {{note|2}} Otherwise it would be impossible to reach or maintain 4 stacks of the effect.<!--riot norak said this allegedly-->
}}

E.name: Disdain

E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Disdain|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Urgot
|skill        = E
|icon         = Disdain.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Urgot}} {{tip|shield|shields}} himself for a few seconds and {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them aside}}.
|blurb2      = '''Urgot''' will stop upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} and {{tip|airborne|flinging}} them over.
|blurb4      = ''Neither '''Urgot's''' dash nor the fling cross [[terrain]].''
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Urgot''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|55 to 135}} {{as|(+ 135% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|13.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
|description2 = After the cast time, '''Urgot''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through, {{tip|airborne|knocking them aside}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|90 to 210}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description3 = '''Urgot''' will stop upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and, after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, also {{tip|airborne|flinging}} them to the location {{tt|100 units behind him|This destination is a fixed location and is unaffected by size modifiers on Urgot or the target moving away before the displacement started}}, though not through terrain.
|description4 = ''{{ai|Purge|Urgot}} can be cast during the dash.''
|target range = {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|475|Maximum range}}|{{tt|450|Minimum range}}}}
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 100}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = {{fd|0.45}}
|speed        = {{tt|1200 + {{as|100% movement speed}}|Dash speed}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|16 to 14}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = Area of Effect
|spellshield  = True
|parry        = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|notes        = 
* '''Urgot''' turns around when tossing an enemy over him, always facing his victim.
* The target will be {{tip|airborne|flung}} to the location behind '''Urgot''' over {{fd|0.5}} seconds given that they do not move nor are moved from the position at which they collided with him while {{tip|stun|stunned}}.
* ''Disdain'' prevents {{ai|Purge|Urgot}} from firing for {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
* The range indicator length is 475 units, but the dash only moves '''Urgot''' 450 units.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The {{tip|shield}} is granted at the start of the cast time while the {{tip|dash}} begins after.
* The {{tip|airborne|fling}} will occur after {{fd|0.25}} seconds regardless of how far away the target is.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will not resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
}}

{{as|'''current''' health}} once the recast's chains hit, even if they are {{tip|heal|healed}}. ** If the target has {{tip|invulnerability}} that persists for the duration of the channel, it will protect them from the execution. *** {{ai|Undying Rage|Tryndamere}} will prevent {{ci|Tryndamere}} from dying by the execute.
